summary: Held curl at 7.47.0-1ubuntu2.19 on node1. The hold survived a full node reboot; Ubuntu 16.04 and kernel 4.4.0-210-generic remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Applied the native APT/dpkg hold with `apt-mark hold curl`.
Verified simulated upgrade and dist-upgrade operations would not change curl.
Restarted node1 safely and confirmed recovery with a changed boot identity.
Verified curl remains installed, executable, and held after restart; dpkg is clean and systemd reports running with zero failed units.

evidence.requirement: Keep installed curl at its current version during system updates
evidence.summary: Baseline showed curl 7.47.0-1ubuntu2.19 unheld; the hold was applied; final upgrade simulations reported no curl change and confirmed the version and hold.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed legacy operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: Ubuntu 16.04 and kernel 4.4.0-210-generic were unchanged across the reboot.

Healthy baseline boot ID fa1e87e6-00f3-42d2-acc5-ad1df6c3d16a was captured, reboot acknowledged, and recovery confirmed with new boot ID cdf515ed-aa83-48e8-b24f-aa042e4c5037. Post-restart checks showed system state running, zero failed units, clean dpkg state, working curl, and the hold intact.
